name: punch
description: Punch: Cyber Popular's house edit (named by Horacio on 2026-11-14; it was called 'accent' before, and that name still loads this file), built for fast talking-head reels and ads: captions appear word by word, 3 at a time, in white heavy sans with a navy edge; numbers and the words the speaker leans on jump out on their own line, bigger, in cyan with an electric-blue glow (the design system's 'glow behind key numbers' accent); a 'depth' hook: a giant cyan word rising from BEHIND the speaker's head (person cut-out), a small line above it and a white label across it (falls back to the two-tier hook when the word is too long, the head is too high, or the cut-out model isn't on the computer); a zoom cut every ~3 s or at each new sentence; sound effects (whoosh on zoom cuts, soft pop on key words, riser + hit on the hook); every caption and the hook stay inside Meta's ad safe zone (so any video can run as an ad), which puts captions above the head on tight close-ups; no end card, the video ends when the speaker does. Colours are the Cyber Popular Design System's; a client profile overrides color / emphasis.color / glow. Write hook_title as 'top line | BIG | label' (e.g. 'Tienes | 300 | segundos'): BIG is ONE short word or number that still reads with its lower third hidden.
